editorial:
You walk into a family reunion that turns into a nightmare when an earthquake shakes an old apartment building and unleashes a flesh-possessing demon. Beth arrives to see her sister Ellie, but the happy visit quickly becomes a fight for survival as Ellie and her kids are pulled into chaos. Tight hallways, dark rooms, and family tension make every scene feel close and dangerous. You are not watching a slow burn; you are thrown into panic almost right away, with blood, screams, and desperate choices around every corner. It keeps the Evil Dead spirit alive in a fresh city setting.

The acting sells the fear, especially when family members turn against each other, and the action stays fast without losing gross-out fun. Practical effects look nasty in a good way, and the pacing rarely lets you breathe. Some moments are intense, so sensitive viewers may want to skip it, and a few scares feel familiar if you know the series. Still, if you like loud, bloody horror with strong characters, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Beth fights the possessed Ellie in the parking garage and uses a chainsaw to stop her. Danny and Bridget are lost to possession, and Beth protects Kassie through the chaos. After the final fight, Beth and Kassie escape the building together, but the last shot hints the demon is still out there, so the danger is not over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves bloody horror and family survival stories.
